"""Independent exact-candidate probes; all journal writes target temporary local fixture repositories."""
import copy, unittest
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from loop_health import worker_observation
from lab_controller import _poll_observations
from jules_dispatch import COMPLETED_STATES, FAILED_STATES
from dispatch_journal import JournalConflict, NEXT, CONTINUE
from dispatch_journal_test import JournalTests, CONTROL
from state_store import load_state
NOW=datetime(2026,10,25,21,0,tzinfo=timezone.utc)

def observation(state='COMPLETED',identifier='sessions/abc_123'):
 return worker_observation({'id':'synthetic','execution':{'session_id':identifier,'session_state':state}},NOW)

class SafetyScenarios(unittest.TestCase):
 def fixture(self):
  f=JournalTests('test_existing_claim_noop_reload_and_new_owner_never_issue_another_capability'); f.setUp();self.addCleanup(f.doCleanups);return f
 def test_fail_closed(self):
  for identifier in (None,'','../bad','sessions/x/y','x?token=fixture','https://foreign.invalid/x'):
   o=observation(identifier=identifier);self.assertIsNone(o['session_id']);self.assertEqual(_poll_observations({'observations':[o]}),[])
  for o in (observation('UNKNOWN'),dict(observation(),reason='controller_error'),dict(observation(),reason='worker_wait_prolonged')):
   self.assertEqual(_poll_observations({'observations':[o]}),[])
  self.assertEqual(_poll_observations({'observations':[observation()]},recovery=True),[])
  f=self.fixture();intent,cap=f.execute();before=f.store.current();sha=before['state_sha']
  with self.assertRaises(JournalConflict):
   f.store.record_effect(cap,'controller_checkpoint',{'before_state_sha':sha,'after_state_sha':sha,'poll_observations':_poll_observations({'observations':[observation()]})})
  self.assertEqual(f.store.current(),before)
 def test_identity_preservation(self):
  for state,reason in [(s,'worker_completed') for s in COMPLETED_STATES]+[(s,'worker_failed') for s in FAILED_STATES]:
   task={'id':'synthetic','execution':{'session_id':'sessions/abc_123','session_state':state,'dispatch_key':'saved-identity','attempt':1}};before=copy.deepcopy(task)
   o=worker_observation(task,NOW);self.assertEqual(task,before);self.assertEqual(o['reason'],reason);self.assertEqual(o['session_id'],'abc_123');self.assertEqual(o['session_state'],state)
   old=dict(o,reason='worker_running');self.assertEqual(_poll_observations({'observations':[o]}),_poll_observations({'observations':[old]}));self.assertEqual(set(_poll_observations({'observations':[o]})[0]),{'task_id','session_id','session_state','observed_at'})
 def test_bound_terminal_checkpoint(self):
  from lab_controller_test import ControllerTests
  c=ControllerTests("test_completed_owner_proposal_releases_worker_without_accepting_it");c.setUp();self.addCleanup(c.doCleanups);c.run_tick();c.reload()
  for state in sorted(COMPLETED_STATES | FAILED_STATES):
   f=self.fixture();data=load_state(f.repo,f.store.manifest_path,f.store.revision_path);t=copy.deepcopy(c.data["tasks"][0]);t["execution"]["session_state"]=state;data["tasks"]=[t];data["controller"]={"last_poll_at":NOW.isoformat()};f.store.save_manifest(data)
   intent,cap=f.execute();sha=f.store.current()["state_sha"];o=worker_observation(t,NOW);payload=_poll_observations({"observations":[o]});receipt=f.store.record_effect(cap,"controller_checkpoint",{"before_state_sha":sha,"after_state_sha":sha,"poll_observations":payload});current=f.store.current();self.assertEqual(current["effects"][intent["decision_id"]]["evidence"]["poll_observations"],payload)
   with self.assertRaises(JournalConflict):f.store.record_effect(cap,"controller_checkpoint",{"before_state_sha":sha,"after_state_sha":sha,"poll_observations":payload})
   self.assertEqual(f.store.current(),current)
 def test_no_replayed_effects(self):
  f=self.fixture();intent,cap=f.execute();receipt=f.checkpoint(cap);before=f.store.current()
  with self.assertRaises(JournalConflict):f.checkpoint(cap)
  after=f.store.current();self.assertEqual(after['effects'],before['effects']);self.assertEqual(after['executor_claims'],before['executor_claims']);self.assertEqual(after['frontier_seq'],before['frontier_seq'])
  _,replay=f.store.admit(NEXT,{},key=intent['correlation_key'],trigger=f.trigger('20','2'),control_sha=CONTROL);self.assertIsNone(replay)
 def test_scope_non_escalation(self):
  f=self.fixture();intent,send=f.reserve();send.consume();before=f.store.current()
  with self.assertRaises(JournalConflict):f.store.record_effect(send,'controller_checkpoint',{'poll_observations':_poll_observations({'observations':[observation()]})})
  self.assertEqual(f.store.current(),before)
  for state in ('COMPLETED','FAILED','PAUSED','IN_PROGRESS'):
   result={'observations':[observation(state)],'action':'none','merge_mode':'manual','execution_allowed':False};old=copy.deepcopy(result);_poll_observations(result);self.assertEqual(result,old)
  f2=self.fixture();_,cap=f2.execute(workflow=CONTINUE);before=f2.store.current();sha=before['state_sha']
  with self.assertRaises((JournalConflict,ValueError)):
   f2.store.record_effect(cap,'controller_checkpoint',{'before_state_sha':sha,'after_state_sha':sha})
  self.assertEqual(f2.store.current(),before)
